title: Palacio de Vidrio Espejo ukan uñacht’ayata
intro: Wali qamirïki ukat kʼajkir jachʼa oraqen amuytʼañäni, ukanjja Luriripar yupaychañat sipansa, Intiruw yupaychapjje. Mä cartajj mä jawsäwimpiw purini, ukajj janiw jan yäqañjamäkiti, ukat nayrajj uñjatäkäna ukat sipansa jukʼamp jachʼa tribunalaruw sarañ qalltaraki. Ukanxa, ilusión ukax mä pampampiw uñacht’ayasini, ukax nayranakar sallqjañapawa, ukat mä juk’a qhanax taqi kuns mayjt’ayaspawa.
clues: Nayax mä qamir uraqiruw apnaqawayta, uka uraqin jaqinakax Allah lantix intiruw qunqurt’asipxäna.
Mä jach’a carta katuqta, ukax janiw jach’añchasiñajati jan ukasti Allah ukar jaysañajatakiw jawsitu.
Consejojaruw jisktʼasiyäta ukat nayraqat diplomacia ajlliwayta, khititï khitirus yantʼañatakejj mä regalo apayayäta.
Sulayman markaruw jutta, ukat naya pachpaw tronojax disfrazata uñacht’ayapxitu, uñt’atätax yant’añataki.
Mä jachʼa palacioruw mantayäta, uka palacion suma vidriot lurat pisopajj manqhankir umaw sasaw pantjasiyäta.
Nayax Sulayman jupamp chikaw Allah, akapachan Tatitupar katuyasiñax yatiyawayta.

trial.label: Yant’awi/Evento
options: Quta manqhanxa mä jach’a challwa manq’antatawa
Walja maranaka usuntata ukat familiapan chhaqhata
Mä munat wawar samkan sacrificiot luqtañataki kamachi
Disfrazat tronompi ukat vidriot lurat palaciompiw yantʼata
Idolonak pʼakjañatakejj nina nakhaskir ninar jaqontatäpjjewa
trial.answer: Disfrazat tronompi ukat vidriot lurat palaciompiw yantʼata

arabic: فَلَمَّا جَآءَتْ قِيلَ أَهَـٰكَذَا عَرْشُكِ ۖ قَالَتْ كَأَنَّهُۥ هُوَ ۚ وَأُوتِينَا ٱلْعِلْمَ مِن قَبْلِهَا وَكُنَّا مُسْلِمِينَ
verse: So when she arrived, it was said [to her], "Is your throne like this?" She said, "[It is] as though it was it." [Solomon said], "And we were given knowledge before her, and we have been Muslims [in submission to Allāh]. (27:42)
